img_476.description: Large circular diagram with three concentric bands of text. A red-painted horned quadruped stands in the centre, turned toward a basket of green leaves. Around it, mostly nude women stand or lean in rings, each holding a line that ends in an eight-pointed star. One woman in the inner ring sits in a tub. There is a hole in the vellum on the left, and part of another diagram shows on the facing page.
img_476.central_figure: A red four-legged animal with tall horns curving upward, cloven hooves and a tufted tail. It reaches toward a basket of green foliage while standing on a green ground line.
img_476.sign_reason: Horned hoofed quadruped. The heavy red body and the tail ending in a tuft look more like a bull than a ram or goat; the horns are tall and thin, which leaves some doubt (Aries is the alternative). No fish tail, so not Capricorn.
img_476.rings: Three text bands. There are three figure zones: about 5 figures nearest the centre, about 10 in the middle and about 10-12 in the outer ring.
img_476.figure_details: Mostly nude women with long hair, standing or leaning. Some wear head-cloths or hats. One inner figure stands in a cylindrical tub or barrel. Each holds a string or arm out to a star.
img_476.celestial_objects: About 25 eight-pointed stars, one per figure, some painted gold. No sun or moon.
img_476.groupings: The figures are spaced evenly around concentric rings, each with a short label word and its own star.
img_476.astro_concept: About 30 figures, each with a star, around a sign emblem would fit the 30 degrees of the sign (or the days of the month). Each star-holder could be one degree or day, possibly a star of the constellation.
img_476.other: There is a vellum hole at the left. A painted-over patch below the animal probably hid a word, perhaps a month name.

img_941.description: Circular diagram with two concentric text bands. A pale red, sketchily coloured horned animal stands at the centre beside a basket of green leaves. The figures are clothed (red-tinted garments), shown half-length and set in tubs or boxes. Several wear green hats or turbans, and each holds a star on a string. One figure in the middle ring stands in an arched tower-like tub.
img_941.central_figure: A pinkish-red horned quadruped with long curved horns and hooves, reaching toward a basket of greenery.
img_941.sign_reason: The composition matches img_476 (red horned beast with a basket of leaves), and the reddish bovine body suggests a bull. A ram or goat (Aries) is possible because the horns are slender.
img_941.rings: Two text bands: an inner ring of about 5 figures and an outer ring of about 10.
img_941.figure_details: All the figures are clothed in red-washed garments. Several wear green hats. Most emerge from tubs, boxes or barrels, one with arches. Each holds a star on a line.
img_941.celestial_objects: About 15 eight-pointed stars, one per figure. No sun or moon.
img_941.groupings: Inner ring about 5, outer ring about 10. The figures are evenly spaced and each has a label word.
img_941.astro_concept: Each star-holding figure could stand for one degree or day of the sign. With about 15 it may be half of a 30-part sign (the page may be one of two halves), or the stars of the constellation.
img_941.other: This is the clothed and coloured counterpart of the nude-figure style seen in other images. A masked patch sits under the animal.

img_806.description: Circular diagram with three text bands, extending to the top of the page where a row of figures is cut off. A small archer in a blue tunic and a broad hat stands in the centre, holding a crossbow. Around him, many nude women recline or lean in two rings, each holding a star. Some wear crowns.
img_806.central_figure: A man in a blue tunic and wide-brimmed hat aiming or holding a crossbow.
img_806.sign_reason: The central figure is an archer (crossbowman). Sagittarius is the archer sign; there is no other archer in the zodiac.
img_806.rings: Three text bands. The inner ring of figures has about 10, the outer ring about 15-20, and there is a partial row beyond at the top.
img_806.figure_details: Nude women, many reclining or leaning at angles. A few wear crowns or caps. No tubs are visible. Each holds a string to a star.
img_806.celestial_objects: About 30 eight-pointed stars. No sun or moon.
img_806.groupings: Concentric rings, and a group of figures at the top outside the main circle. The figures are evenly spaced.
img_806.astro_concept: About 30 figure-and-star units around the sign emblem fit the 30 degrees of the sign or the days of the month.
img_806.other: A masked patch sits by the archer's legs and another at the upper left. There are green stains at the lower left.

img_793.description: Faint circular diagram with three text bands. A cat-like or lion-like beast stands in the centre with blue spots and a red spot, beside a small plant. Around it, many nude women stand in the upper rings and lean or recline lower down, each holding a star.
img_793.central_figure: A four-legged feline beast (big cat, lion-like) with a heavy head and spotted body.
img_793.sign_reason: The central animal is a large cat with a big head and paws, which fits a lion. No horns or hooves.
img_793.rings: Three text bands, with about 10 figures in the inner and middle rings and more in the outer ring.
img_793.figure_details: Nude women, standing at the top and leaning or reclining at the sides and bottom. No tubs or clothing are evident. Each holds a star.
img_793.celestial_objects: About 30 eight-pointed stars. No sun or moon.
img_793.groupings: Concentric rings, evenly spaced. The figures are crowded together in the outer ring.
img_793.astro_concept: About 30 star-holders around the sign emblem suggest the degrees of the sign or the days of the month.
img_793.other: There are stains at the upper left and a fold line. A masked patch sits under the animal.

img_489.description: Circular diagram with two text bands. A pale (uncoloured) horned, bearded goat-like animal stands at the centre on a green, scalloped ground and nibbles a green branch. Around it, clothed figures emerge from striped tubs or boxes painted blue, green and red, each holding a star.
img_489.central_figure: A white or pale goat or ram with backward-curving horns and a beard, eating a leafy sprig.
img_489.sign_reason: A horned, bearded, hoofed small animal (goat or ram) with an ordinary hind body, not a fish tail. Aries fits; Capricorn is the alternative, but there is no fish tail.
img_489.rings: Two text bands: about 5 figures inside and about 10 outside.
img_489.figure_details: Clothed figures in red-tinted garments, some with hats or caps, in coloured tubs, barrels or crate-like boxes (blue, green, striped). Each holds a star on a string.
img_489.celestial_objects: About 15 eight-pointed stars. No sun or moon.
img_489.groupings: Inner ring about 5, outer ring about 10.
img_489.astro_concept: Each figure-and-star could be one degree or day; with about 15 it may be one half of a sign split over two pages, or a set of stars.
img_489.other: Same style as img_941 (clothed, in tubs). A masked patch sits under the animal, and there is a brown stain at the right.

img_991.description: Circular diagram with three text bands. A balance (scales) with two pans hangs at the centre. Around it, many nude women stand, lean or recline in two or three rings, each holding a star. One wears a crown with a cross. There is a hole in the vellum at the right.
img_991.central_figure: A pair of scales: a beam with two hanging pans on an upright stand.
img_991.sign_reason: The central object is unmistakably a balance, the emblem of Libra.
img_991.rings: Three text bands, with about 10 figures in the inner ring and about 20 in the outer ring.
img_991.figure_details: Nude women. One is crowned with a cross-topped crown. No tubs. Each holds a star.
img_991.celestial_objects: About 30 eight-pointed stars. No sun or moon.
img_991.groupings: Evenly spaced figures in concentric rings.
img_991.astro_concept: About 30 star-holders fit the 30 degrees of the sign (or the days of the month).
img_991.other: A masked patch sits under the scales.

img_129.description: Circular diagram with several concentric bands, including a ring of hatched, ladder-like decoration. Two fish lie at the centre, one above the other, with a curved line between them and stars above and below. Around them, half-length women sit in tubs or barrels (some painted green, some striped or dotted). Several wear blue head-cloths, and each holds a star.
img_129.central_figure: Two fish, one above the other, joined by a curved line or cord.
img_129.sign_reason: Two fish joined by a cord is the classic emblem of Pisces.
img_129.rings: Three or four bands: an inner band of about 10 figures in green tubs inside a hatched ring, and an outer band of about 20 figures in patterned barrels.
img_129.figure_details: Women shown from the waist up in barrels or tubs (green-painted, hatched, dotted or ribbed). Some wear blue head-cloths and some appear nude. Each holds a star on a string.
img_129.celestial_objects: About 30 eight-pointed stars, two of them flanking the fish. No sun or moon.
img_129.groupings: An inner ring of about 10 and an outer ring of about 20. Evenly spaced.
img_129.astro_concept: About 30 figure-and-star units suggest the degrees of the sign or the days of the month. The stars might also mark constellation stars.
img_129.other: There is a fold line across the page. A masked patch sits between the fish.

img_241.description: Circular diagram with three text bands on a fold-out page, with neighbouring diagrams at the edges. Two small crustaceans, one green and one red, sit at the centre. Around them, many nude women stand, lean or recline in rings, each holding a star.
img_241.central_figure: Two crayfish or lobster-like crustaceans, one pale green and one red, stacked one above the other.
img_241.sign_reason: Clawed, segmented crustaceans (crab or crayfish) are the emblem of Cancer.
img_241.rings: Three text bands: inner about 10 figures, outer about 20.
img_241.figure_details: Nude women standing (top) and reclining (sides and bottom). One wears a crown. No tubs. Each holds a star.
img_241.celestial_objects: About 30 eight-pointed stars. No sun or moon.
img_241.groupings: Concentric rings with evenly spaced figures.
img_241.astro_concept: About 30 figure-and-star units fit the 30 degrees of the sign or the days of the month.
img_241.other: A masked patch sits below the crustaceans. This is a fold-out sheet with adjacent diagrams visible.

img_396.description: Circular diagram with three text bands. A small dark green creature sits at the centre under a large star: four legs, open-jawed snout and a long tail curled up into a loop. Around it, many nude women stand at the top and lean or recline elsewhere, each with a star. A partial row of figures extends above the circle.
img_396.central_figure: A small dark green beast like a lizard, salamander or dog, with an open snout and a looped tail, with a large star above it.
img_396.sign_reason: The animal is not a scorpion as such, but a reptile- or dragon-like creature with a curled-up tail; a raised curling tail hints at a scorpion's stinger. It does not fit the lion, ram, bull, goat or fish. This is uncertain.
img_396.rings: Three text bands: about 10 in the inner ring and about 15-20 in the outer, with more at the top.
img_396.figure_details: Nude women. No tubs or clothing. Standing at the top, reclining and leaning around the rest. Each holds a star.
img_396.celestial_objects: About 30 eight-pointed stars, plus one larger star above the central animal.
img_396.astro_concept: About 30 figure-and-star units fit the degrees of the sign or the days of the month. The large star above the animal might mark a bright star of the constellation.
img_396.other: A masked patch sits below the animal.

img_896.description: Circular diagram with two text bands. A dark green, bearded, horned goat-like animal stands at the centre on a pale blue cloud-like ground and reaches up to eat from a green bush. Around it, women emerge from tubs or barrels (patterned with spirals, dots, hatching), each holding a star. Some are clothed or wear head-cloths.
img_896.central_figure: A green-grey goat or ram with curved horns and a beard, eating leaves from a small tree.
img_896.sign_reason: A horned, bearded, hoofed small animal on four ordinary legs. It is a ram or goat, with no fish tail (so not Capricorn) and not a bull. It matches img_489.
img_896.rings: Two text bands: about 5 figures inside and about 10 outside.
img_896.figure_details: Women from the waist up in decorated tubs or barrels (hatched, dotted, spiral, one green-striped). Some appear clothed with patterned bodices, and some wear head-cloths. Each holds a star.
img_896.celestial_objects: About 15 eight-pointed stars. No sun or moon.
img_896.groupings: Inner ring about 5, outer ring about 10.
img_896.astro_concept: Each star-holding figure could be one degree or day; with about 15 it may be half of a 30-part sign split across two pages.
img_896.other: A masked patch sits under the animal. This is the darker-coloured counterpart to img_489.

img_477.description: Circular diagram with three text bands and a neighbouring diagram partly visible at the left. A single seated or kneeling figure in a long blue-striped robe and a blue cap sits at the centre, with a star near the head. The figure holds something (partly masked), and a small flower or plant is at its feet. Around it, many nude women stand at the top and recline elsewhere, each holding a star.
img_477.central_figure: One person in a long blue robe and cap, apparently holding an object (perhaps a flower or sprig, obscured by the mask), with a small flower beside them.
img_477.sign_reason: A single robed human with a flower or plant is the usual Virgo emblem (a maiden holding a sprig or ear of grain). There is only one person, so not Gemini; there is no water vessel, so probably not Aquarius. The cap makes the gender ambiguous.
img_477.rings: Three text bands: about 10 in the inner ring and about 20 in the outer.
img_477.figure_details: The surrounding figures are nude women standing or reclining, with no tubs. Each holds a star. The central figure is clothed.
img_477.celestial_objects: About 30 eight-pointed stars, plus one beside the central figure.
img_477.astro_concept: About 30 star-holders fit the 30 degrees of the sign or the days of the month.
img_477.other: Two masked patches: one over the hands or held object, one below the centre.

img_972.description: Circular diagram with three text bands, with neighbouring diagrams at both sides. Two clothed people stand at the centre facing each other and holding hands: one in a green tunic and green hat, the other a long-haired person in a long blue gown. Around them, nude women stand at the top and recline or lean around the rest; a few lower figures appear clothed. Each holds a star.
img_972.central_figure: A couple, a man in a green tunic and hat and a woman in a blue gown, holding hands.
img_972.sign_reason: Two human figures paired together are the emblem of Gemini (the twins, often drawn as a couple).
img_972.rings: Three text bands: about 10 in the inner ring and about 20 in the outer.
img_972.figure_details: Mostly nude women standing or reclining. A few lower figures wear clothes or are in tub-like garments. Each holds a star.
img_972.celestial_objects: About 30 eight-pointed stars. No sun or moon.
img_972.groupings: Concentric rings, evenly spaced. The central pair is the focal point.
img_972.astro_concept: About 30 star-holders fit the 30 degrees of the sign or the days of the month.
img_972.other: A masked patch sits between the couple's lower bodies. This is a fold-out sheet.

recognise_source: Yes: these are the zodiac pages of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), recognisable from the script, the nude star-holding women in tubs and the concentric rings.
